title: GUT
summary: Godot Unit Test: test scripts that extend GutTest, with asserts, signal watching, frame waits, doubles and stubs, run headless by a command-line runner.
useWhen: The game has rules or systems worth checking automatically (damage, inventory, save data, state machines, level generation) and you want tests that run headless with godot_script after each change.
avoidWhen: A one-off check is enough: print the values in a game run or read them with godot_eval instead.
